comment.narrative: 2 radio announcements 6 community open dialogue forums 6 community information sessions 9 press visits to action sites 9 press releases.

1 radio advertisement to announce the project was broadcasted on the local station Alshabab FM6 community meetings to announce the project were conducted across various project locations with the objective of announcing key details about the projectOne press release was produced as a part of the projects efforts to announce the project to community members giving them the opportunity to know about the projects objectives services offered targeted groups and implementation areas.one community information session out of 8 sessions scheduled for year 1 was held in September 2023.6 feedback complaints and suggestions boxes were installed in CBOs where the projects activities are implemented encouraging beneficiaries to issue any complaintsuggestionfeedback to be reviewed and considered according to rules. Other engagement activities Banners for the action were designed approved and printed to be used during the implementation of project activities. 2 radio sessions were planned to be implemented in 10 October the World Mental Health Day and on 3 December International Day of People with Disabilities but the conflict stopped their implementation. 2 Press visits were scheduled in October and December and they are halted too. The shortfeatured film shots were taken during the activities and was planned to be released on December 2023 after finishing other activities. The agreement with media company to produce the infographic fact sheet was completed to start working but had no progress in year1. The second press release for year 1was planned to be disseminated on November 2023 along with the infographic fact sheet.
